env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
mkdir -p "$out"
if [ -d target ]; then
  chmod -R u+w target
  find target -name '.cargo*lock' -delete
fi
cargo nextest --version
cargo nextest archive \
  --cargo-profile ci-optim \
  --offline -p feynkit-generator \
  -E 'package(feynkit-generator)' \
  --profile ci_gammaloop \
  --archive-file "$out/gammaloop-nextest-feynkit-feynkit-generator.tar.zst"

runHook postBuild
env.configurePhase:
runHook preConfigure
echo default configurePhase, nothing to do
runHook postConfigure
env.name: gammaloop-nextest-binaries-feynkit-feynkit-generator-0.1.0

# Query caches have their own output in stateful test producers. Other
# archives share compiled libraries without retaining those large caches.

  rm -rf "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/${CARGO_PROFILE}/incremental"
fi
